notes:
Summary: Rapidicore builds ultra-low-latency trading signal generation and wants to replace a costly in-house inference stack. They are highly cost-sensitive — looking to cut per-token/op cost via batching/caching/quantization and need reproducible perf benchmarks. Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and Private (VPC) for compliance.

Deal context: evaluation stage; AE introduced via conference demo. Rapidicore has a 6-week POC budgeted. POC ask: demonstrate p50/p95 token latency targets and cost projections comparing quantized vs fp16 models. Also want KV-prefix caching experiments to reduce tail latency on repeated prompts.

Requirements (from call):
- Workloads: real-time signal gen + reranking pipeline (fan-out 1:4), spikes during market open.
- Latency targets: p95 < 100ms for 128-token responses; p50 < 30ms.
- Throughput target: sustained 400 req/s, burst to 2k req/s for 120s windows.
- Cost sensitivity: internal cost target < $0.002 per response (128 tokens).
- Model prefs: open Llama-derivative or comparable; receptive to INT8/4 quantization if quality preserved.
- Routing/fallback: prefer regional routing (NA primary, fallback eu-west), automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant when backlog > 200ms.
- Security: SAML SSO, SOC2/AICPA, KMS integration, EU data residency.

Notes from last call: "We need repeatable perf numbers — send a benchmark harness and sample client load config." AE: Samira to share perf harness template and request required dataset. SE: Liam to run initial perf tests on dedicated c5/gpu-equivalent and share results.

POC milestones:
- Week 1: infra kickoff + SSO + data residency confirmation.
- Week 2-3: initial perf runs (baseline fp16), gather p50/p95, token/sec.
- Week 4: quantized runs (INT8/4), KV-cache experiments, batching config tuning.
- Week 5: cost analysis and final report.
- Week 6: exec review + procurement handoff.

Sticking points: procurement needs vendor DPA + EU residency proof, legal pushback on logging retention. CTO asked for sample kernel-level perf numbers and guidance on autoscaling strategy.

Communication: frequent — weekly standups, Slack channel created (rapidicore-redwood), drive deck linked above.

Quoted priorities: "Latency is the product; cost is how we scale it."
customer_notes: User comments and call excerpts: 'If p95 climbs above 100ms during open, strategy fails.'; 'Quantization ok if hit quality bar — we'll validate with our backtest set.'; 'We'd prefer Dedicated with consistent warm KV cache.';\nSales notes: ROI case sensitive, show both latency and $/req improvements; procurement timeline ~6 weeks.
